items.item: 08 §2 'Where the ethics sits' (H1-H10, E1, F2, F4-F6)
items.how: Rewritten on the first screen's anchor at the method's depth. Keeps 'The ethics emerges from continuation.' and says its sense once (H10): '"Emerges" names neither a derivation nor a shown development: what is shown is conditional, with self-concern and the condition as hypotheses, on a finite listing and, one way, between courses whose admissions end; what is offered is counting the losses of those whose loss never returns (below); and what is open is how such orders form.' Then H3: 'That a life forms one is not shown: in the proofs self-concern is a hypothesis, and what the models show of persisting is a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed (07 §4.9); how scope and order form within the dynamics is the work's open target (§12, item 12).' H7/F2: 'Where relations close, read across all steps, so that every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, nothing lies outside each one's reach along that relation; on the reading that what has significance from a standpoint is what lies within its center's reach, that is the continuation condition.' Bullets: the condition's bullet adds Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent (along being affected and along affecting), says the relations are read across all steps (depending and exchanging each at some step, in either order, no step index on being affected, so nothing of what comes before what; nothing said of what holds in time, J3's), and H6 'Where «续无外» holds along an acyclic relation, every standpoint has the same center' (the 'as among dated occurrences' gloss dropped). The order's bullet adds H2's 'whose proof uses the condition only at the standpoint whose order it is', H8 'so these are courses whose admissions end', and H9 'Mutual dependence and this ranking compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite', naming the two theorems and why they compose (same Web, any rel). The widening bullet says H1 exactly ('every additive weighting that counts each listed item above zero ranks it higher'; widens_iff_every_of_class 'says nothing of an order outside such a class'), H2 ('So ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: where the condition holds, that concern already does it.'), H5 ('C names the requirement that an order rank each course above every course it widens ... an order meeting it may rank mixed pairs as well, and it asks neither completeness nor transitivity'; 'C is no longer introduced as a second foundation of the ethics; the name stays for the requirement particular theorems take.'), the dated history kept (E10). The one-way paragraph says H4: 'concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: nothing in it requires their losses to count', with Clearing.center_not_derived read as the witness it is and increasingInOwn_of_increasing for 'nor does self-concern exclude them'.
H1 (additive weighting counting each listed item above zero), H8 ('so that their admissions end'), H5 ('a result taking another order, or the requirement C (`Comparison`), names it').
